prospectiveExperiment.baseline: Snapshot of current skills, loaded references, input material and model settings
prospectiveExperiment.candidate: candidate-workflow.md integrated only for the tested editorial stage
prospectiveExperiment.control: Same fresh topic, evidence, author brief, model/version and settings; record known nondeterminism and loaded files
prospectiveExperiment.review: Randomize A/B order; collect author/reader preference, concrete reasons and uncertainty separately from source checks and scanner output
prospectiveExperiment.promotion: Do not infer writing improvement from higher self-scores or one historical replay; repeat on a held-out topic before adopting a broad default
